pluginId.description: The ID of the plugin for which we are attempting to exchange the code for an access token for.

authLinkId.description: Optional existing auth link to renew. It must belong to the requester, reference this plugin, and permit auth-link-write; renewal preserves its endpoint and route identities.

principalId.description: The ID of the principal to exchange the code for an access token for, or alternatively ~self, when the target is the current user principal.

authorizationVariantId.description: Authorization variant being established. Optional when the plugin has one variant; a renewal keeps the link's stored variant and rejects a different one.

regionalizationId.description: Regionalization being established. Optional only when the chosen variant allows exactly one; a renewal keeps the link's stored regionalization and rejects a different one. Changing region or variant requires connecting a new link.

pluginAuthenticationData.description: The data to exchange the code with. This is opaque data that is bespoke to the plugin and the plugin's authentication flow.
